svg.title: The prophet's view and history's view
svg.desc: Two views of the 118 prophecies of Christ in this site's ledger. The prophet's view: 17 of them the New Testament divides between His first coming and His coming in glory, one text holding both like two mountain peaks lined up, the valley between them hidden (1 Peter 1:11, the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow). History's view: the 71 prophecies tied to a dated event, each drawn from the year it was written to the year it came to pass. The median is 483 years ahead on the traditional dates; 19 are in texts critical scholarship dates later, 19 of them still before the event. The earliest is Exodus 12:46; Psalm 34:20. 14 were fulfilled in part, and the rest of each waits beyond the valley, at His return.
